g.text: per-region units and cleared energy printed, coverage measured

cmd: just nemosis-fetch DISPATCHLOAD "2025/09/01 00:00:00" "2025/09/02 00:00:00" && just nemosis-fetch DUDETAILSUMMARY "2025/09/01 00:00:00" "2025/09/02 00:00:00" | pass: each prints 'nemosis-fetch: <TABLE> rows=<N> sha256=<prefix>'
cmd: just nem-unit-lookup | pass: prints a row per region then 'nem-unit-lookup: dispatched_duids=N mapped=M coverage=C' and 'PASS nem-unit-lookup' when coverage is at least 0.99
